patch_description: Crossover of the multi-start coordinate-search pipeline (score 0.82, fast eval) with the annealed soft-min explorer (score 0.80). Key combination ideas: (1) keep the fast multi-seed soft_search → hard_refine pipeline that dominates on efficiency; (2) add the annealed soft-min group-move phase (coordinated perturbation of the smallest-triangle vertices with Metropolis acceptance) as an additional refinement stage applied to the winner, since it escapes pinning configurations single-point moves cannot; (3) keep directed_polish and pair_exchange structured escapes afterward; (4) reuse a single precomputed triplet index array for all area computations to cut overhead. Fixed seeds ensure determinism; the try/except fallback guarantees graceful failure handling.
